text:
maria: Quick sync — we need a short, actionable playbook for model entry + sunset that sales can rely on. low friction but clear.
aj: Non-negotiables? p95 latency targets, embed regressions, and a minimal eval set.
sam: Add a migration window  call it 'twilight' — e.g. 90 days default; customers get migration credits that decay over time.
lina: 'Twilight' works. Also propose a 7-day canary at a fraction of prod QPS before marking GA.
ev: Bench proposal: p95 under target, embed cosine recall >= 0.85 on key slices OR within -5% of tenant baseline, and no safety regressions on guard prompts.
maria: Draft rubric: 1) Perf: p95, mem/KV footprint; 2) Quality: small representative eval (10-20 prompts) + CI regression; 3) Stability: canary window; 4) Migration contract: twilight + optional compat shim + pin policy.
aj: Canary requirement should be conditional. Small families (<=6B) can have expedited path.
sam: Pin policy: default TTL = 30 days post-GA unless customer purchases a pin SLA. Make exceptions for enterprise in contract.
lina: Sales asks: paid hard-pins. Offer paid exception with documented SLA and clear rev share. Add checkbox in contract.
ev: Deprecation flow: Notice -> Migration credits -> Compat shim (if feasible) -> Sunset after twilight. Console should have a 'migration' tile to track tenants and credits.
ops-bot: Canary infra checklist: ticket template `CANARY-REQ: model, qps, start_ts, end_ts, fallback_model`.
maria: Acceptance gates: small eval required for entry; heavy regression suite runs in CI. If heavy suite fails, block GA and schedule triage.
aj: Representative prompts owned by Product + Solutions Eng + customer opt-in.
sam: Make embed rule flexible: absolute floor OR relative delta to baseline.
lina: Two onboarding tracks: Fastpath (minimal checks, limited to dev/low-rev, e.g., <10k monthly users) vs Fullpath (canary + heavy bench + enterprise pin options).
ev: Monitoring gates: rollback triggers if user-visible error rate >1% OR p95 >2x target for >15m during canary. Ops to confirm thresholds.
maria: Implementation notes for catalog manifest: fields `twilight_window_days`, `canary_qps`, `pin_ttl_days`, `compat_shim` (boolean), `onboard_track` (fast|full).
aj: Next actions: Product to draft rubric doc, Eng to scope canary infra, Sales/Legal to draft pin contract language, Eng/DevEx to design Console migration tile. Owners?
maria: I'll draft the rubric PR in 4 days. @aj own canary infra. @sam prototype migration-credit math. @lina draft contract and comm templates.
aj: Acknowledged.
sam: I'll sketch a simple credits model (credits tied to committed spend, decaying over twilight).
lina: I'll prepare sample deprecation email + contract clause for paid pins.
ev: I'll assemble the regression suite checklist and alerting thresholds.
ops-bot: Created TASK-4882 assigned to maria: model lifecycle rubric draft, due in 5d.
maria: Thanks team. If you see edge cases (regulatory, on-prem), flag here. :thumbsup:
